qualification: Scorer/runtime controls only; preserve original failures separately from model quality.

items.observed: Strict source gate refused historical __pycache__ in the old scorer directory.
items.action: Preserved old directories; copied only individually hash-verified locked files into clean .b/g05-scorer/source snapshots.

items.observed: Initial cached Ubuntu metadata referenced libc-ares2_1.18.1-1ubuntu0.22.04.3_amd64.deb; archive download returned HTTP 404.
items.action: Used exact official Node 16.13.1 archive, verified against the recorded official SHASUMS256 list; no scorer package/version changes.

items.observed: Local TeX tree traversal was slow before a database-only search was configured.
items.action: Generated local ls-R and configured process TEXMFHOME with !! and explicit TEXMFDBS. Real template compilation and PDF-to-PNG succeeded.

items.observed: ImportError: libGL.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
items.action: ldd isolated missing libGL. Extracted libgl1/libglx0/libglvnd0 locally, then cv2 import and both full pipelines passed. No driver installation or global library configuration.

items.observed: /usr/bin/time was absent before the first measured run.
items.action: Used a fresh Python wrapper with exactly one child invocation and Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN.ru_maxrss; final logs include measurements.

items.observed: The malformed fraction produced valid rendered prediction artifacts with original CDM score 0; it was correctly rejected as an expected rendering error.
items.action: Kept complete original result and generated TeX; replaced the error input with an unsupported control sequence and required valid ground truth and failed prediction plus original TeX error. Exact/mismatch thresholds unchanged.

items.observed: Fixed 20-second deadline caught a real prediction renderer with a zero-byte buffered log, so log-text-based proof failed.
items.action: Observe the actual same-group prediction xetex process through /proc, then start a deliberate 0.05-second renderer deadline. Do not count startup expiry as rendering-timeout proof.

items.observed: Initial harness only killed descendants in its TimeoutExpired branch.
items.action: finally cleanup kills whole group, reaps leader and verifies no active descendants. Linux regression covers a remaining descendant after leader exit; final controls all record no active survivors.

items.observed: Unconstrained colored loop returned naturally with F1=0.333; recursive macro candidate returned naturally with F1=0. Neither reached the native 30-second Timer.
items.action: Retain both complete diagnostics; claim only the separately verified outer renderer-deadline control. Native Timer handling remains unvalidated.

items.observed: ImageMagick warned about missing delegates.xml; Pillow warned about palette transparency. One additional native diagnostic had an ICC/grayscale warning.
items.action: No warnings hidden. Positive controls require verified nonwhite PNGs and nonempty boxes, and score 1.0/0.4 as declared.

items.observed: sdist extraction failed on Windows MAX_PATH for an exported derived diagnostic log filename.
items.action: Moved public-only artifact paths longer than 100 repo-relative characters into short artifacts/<id> names; logical/raw path mapping and both hashes preserved. Original raw evaluator files unchanged. Fresh full build verification is tracked by the integration receipt.
